task_summary: Populate specified Task-sheet ranges from Data using two-key lookups, compute GCC net exports as a share of GDP plus summary stats, and calculate the GCC weighted mean in gdp.xlsx without altering workbook formatting or sheet structure.
decomposition_rationale: This task is best split into one foundational spreadsheet I/O and lookup skill and one computation/formula-targeting skill. The first isolates safe workbook manipulation and 2D data retrieval, while the second handles the domain math and placement of formulas or computed results in the Task sheet.

skills.name: evo-spreadsheet-lookup-population
skills.description: Safely load and edit the existing workbook, read the Data sheet into a two-dimensional lookup structure keyed by series code and year, and populate the specified Task-sheet yellow ranges while preserving formatting.
skills.responsibility: Workbook-safe I/O, Excel coordinate/range handling, source-table extraction from the Data sheet, and writing retrieved values or lookup formulas into H12:L17, H19:L24, and H26:L31 only.
dr_sections: Openpyxl 3.1.5 Workbook Input/Output and Sheet Access
Reading Excel Headers and Source Tables Robustly
Mapping Between Excel Ranges and Python Structures

skills.name: evo-economic-metrics-weighted-summary
skills.description: Compute net exports as a percentage of GDP for the six GCC countries, generate summary statistics, and calculate the GDP-weighted GCC mean using Excel-compatible logic such as SUMPRODUCT.
skills.responsibility: Economic and statistical calculations only: derive net exports % of GDP in H35:L40, calculate min/max/median/simple mean/25th percentile/75th percentile, and compute the weighted mean for GCC using valid source values and weights.
dr_sections: Implementing Domain Calculations in Reusable Python Helpers
Formula Recalculation and Evaluation Outside Excel
